argus-local.name: argus-local
argus-local.notes: CADC argus 1.0.27, the OpenCADC CAOM2 TAP service, from its vendor image images.opencadc.org/caom2/argus over PostgreSQL 17 + pgsphere (benchmarks/tap-compare/docker-compose.argus.yml), serving the exported ObsCore corpus as a plain caom2.ObsCore table in place of its Observation-join-Plane view; configuration in benchmarks/tap-compare/targets/argus/, rationale in argus/PROTOCOL.md.

egernia-local-equalcpu.name: egernia-local-equalcpu
egernia-local-equalcpu.notes: The repository's own docker-compose.yml stack (seeded with `uv run --group dataset python -m egernia_dataset.seed`) under benchmarks/tap-compare/argus-equal-cpu/egernia-equalcpu.yml: the parity pins (cpuset 0-7, 8 GiB as 4 db / 2 api / 2 executor) with TAP_API_WORKERS=8 — one uvicorn worker per pinned core, as argus's Tomcat runs one thread per request on all eight — and PostgreSQL's parallel budget re-derived for the resulting pool total.
